DEFECT: "Update Store Logo" is not implemented

WHERE:
Merchant dashboard → /home/store-locations → row Actions → Edit → "Edit Store Location" modal.
Also affects the customer side: storefront location picker at /locations.

STEPS TO RECREATE:
Log in to the merchant dashboard and go to Store Locations (/home/store-locations).
On any location row, click the Actions (…) menu and choose Edit.
Inspect the full "Edit Store Location" modal, scrolling to the bottom.
Open the store's public storefront /locations picker and look at each location card.

EXPECTED RESULT:
Per the ticket title and description, the merchant should be able to see the location's auto-generated icon and replace it with an image (store logo) from the Media Gallery, and that image should then render on the customer-side location card.

ACTUAL RESULT:
There is no logo / icon / image / Media Gallery control anywhere in the Edit Store Location modal. The modal contains only: Store Name, Address, City, Postal Code, Email, Primary Store Number, Alternate Phone Number, Country, State/Province, Territory/Barangay, Opening/Closing Hours, and Set Geolocation. An automated check of the entire modal DOM (including content below the fold) found zero matching controls.

On the customer side, each location card renders only the store's initials on a coloured tile — never an image — via generateInitials(storeLocation.storeName) in p1-customer/app/(routes)/_components/LocationSelector.tsx (lines 262 and 332).

EVIDENCE: TC17-edit-location-modal-NO-logo-control.png (attached — the modal with no logo control)

SCOPE OF THE GAP (confirmed in source, so this is not a UI-only miss):
No logo/image field in the location form (prosperna1/src/pages/home/Location/components/LocationForm/).
No such field on the StoreLocation model.
No API route to upload or persist a location image.
Storefront card has no image branch at all.

This is a whole feature that has not been built, not a small bug — so it likely needs an effort estimate rather than a quick fix.

STEPS: 1. Sort ascending so the caret is active; record the order. 2. Drag the 3rd row to the top. 3. Reload and re-read the order.
EXPECTED RESULT: Dragged row is first, order persists, and the now-misleading caret clears.
EVIDENCE: TC10a-after-drag.png, TC10b-after-reload.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — drag persisted through the reload and the caret cleared.

TEST CASE #11: "Move to page" appears only with more than one page, and moves the row
STEPS: 1. Show all on one page; confirm no Page column. 2. Set page size 10 so the list paginates. 3. Use the first row's Page select to send it to page 2.
EXPECTED RESULT: Control absent on a single page, present when paginated, and actually moves the row.
EVIDENCE: TC11a-no-page-column-single-page.png, TC11b-page-column-present.png, TC11c-after-move-to-page-2.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — appears only when paginated; the row followed its move.

TEST CASE #12: Search combines with the quick filters; reordering disabled while searching
STEPS: 1. Search a term taken from a real row. 2. Check whether the Store Name sorter is still enabled. 3. Apply the Active filter on top of the search.
EXPECTED RESULT: Search narrows the list, sorters disabled while searching, search + status filter combine.
EVIDENCE: TC12a-search-results.png, TC12b-sorters-disabled-while-searching.png, TC12c-search-plus-active-filter.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — sorters correctly inert while filtered, and the two filters compose.

TEST CASE #13: On mobile the table scrolls horizontally without breaking the page
STEPS: 1. Set a 390×844 viewport and open the page. 2. Measure the table container's scroll width vs client width, and the page's own overflow. 3. Scroll the container fully right.
EXPECTED RESULT: The table container scrolls, the page itself does not, and Actions is reachable.
EVIDENCE: TC13a-mobile-locations-table.png, TC13b-mobile-scrolled-right.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — container scrolls (page overflow ≤1px); Actions reachable.

TEST CASE #14: Storefront picker lists locations in the merchant's saved order
STEPS: 1. As merchant, sort ascending and record the Active locations in order. 2. Open the storefront /locations picker as a shopper. 3. Compare the orders.
EXPECTED RESULT: The customer-side picker follows the merchant's arrangement.
EVIDENCE: TC14a-merchant-active-order.png, TC14b-storefront-picker-order.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — picker order matches the merchant's saved order.

TEST CASE #15: A merchant reorder is reflected on the storefront
STEPS: 1. As merchant, re-sort to descending and record the Active order. 2. Load the storefront picker fresh. 3. Compare.
EXPECTED RESULT: The new arrangement reaches the storefront immediately, not after the cache TTL.
EVIDENCE: TC15a-merchant-descending.png, TC15b-storefront-after-reorder.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — the reorder was live storefront-side straight away. This is the ticket's core "should also be seen in the customer side" requirement.

TEST CASE #16: Deactivated locations are absent from the storefront picker
STEPS: 1. As merchant, filter to Inactive and record those names. 2. Open the storefront picker and search each one.
EXPECTED RESULT: No inactive location is ever offered to a shopper.
EVIDENCE: TC16a-merchant-inactive-locations.png, TC16b-storefront-picker.png
ACTUAL RESULT: As expected — none of the inactive locations appear in the picker.

TEST CASE #17: Update Store Logo — location logo/icon from the Media Gallery ❌ FAILED
STEPS: 1. Go to /home/store-locations. 2. On any row, click Actions (…) → Edit. 3. Inspect the whole "Edit Store Location" modal, scrolling to the bottom. 4. Open the public storefront /locations picker and look at each location card.
EXPECTED RESULT: The merchant can see the location's auto-generated icon and replace it with an image (store logo) from the Media Gallery, and that image renders on the customer-side location card.
EVIDENCE: TC17-edit-location-modal-NO-logo-control.png
ACTUAL RESULT: ❌ Not implemented. There is no logo / icon / image / Media Gallery control anywhere in the Edit Store Location modal — it contains only Store Name, Address, City, Postal Code, Email, Primary Store Number, Alternate Phone Number, Country, State/Province, Territory/Barangay, Opening/Closing Hours and Set Geolocation. An automated check of the entire modal DOM (including content below the fold) found zero matching controls. On the customer side each location card renders only the store's initials on a coloured tile, never an image (generateInitials(storeLocation.storeName) in p1-customer/app/(routes)/_components/LocationSelector.tsx, lines 262 and 332).

Scope of the gap — confirmed in source, so this is not a UI-only miss: no logo/image field in the location form, no such field on the StoreLocation model, no API route to upload or persist a location image, and no image branch in the storefront card. This is a whole feature that has not been built, not a small bug, so it likely needs an effort estimate rather than a quick fix.
undefined
Note for transparency — observed, but NOT a defect on this ticket

While testing we noticed the "No Store Locations Yet" empty state briefly appears on a store that does have locations, before the rows render. Including it for full transparency, but to be clear about what it is and isn't:

Where: /home/store-locations, during initial page load.
Cause: FetchAllStoreLocationRequest declares initialData: [], so isLoading is false on first paint and the table renders with zero rows; the '...Loading' placeholder is therefore never shown.
Measured: with a 50ms-interval probe over 4 runs, it appeared in all 4 — but as a single sub-second flicker in 3 of them, and ~1.9s in only 1. This was on a local dev server, which is slower than production.
Age: pre-existing since 2022 (Location.jsx dates to 2022-09-20; the initialData: [] line to 2022-11-30, commit 3bb5eff93).

Assessment: a real but minor, four-year-old cosmetic flicker that this ticket neither caused nor was scoped to fix — not "no issue," but equally not "an issue dev needs to fix" right now. It is a backlog-polish judgement call, and a reasonable call is to leave it alone. No action is requested of dev on this ticket. If ever picked up, it is a one-line change (drop initialData: [] so isLoading behaves as intended) and belongs in its own ticket.
undefined
Conclusion & requested decision

The locations-table and customer-side ordering work is complete and verified — all of the 2026-08-11 corrections are live and correct, and the arrangement demonstrably reaches the storefront. The only outstanding item is the Update Store Logo requirement, which is unbuilt.

@Angelo Kamachi @Dennis Velasco — how should this be handled?

Option A: Build the logo feature under this ticket; it stays in testing until it lands and we re-run TC17.
Option B (our recommendation): Split the logo into its own ticket and let this one pass on the locations-table work alone. If you choose this, please also update this ticket's title and description, so the requirement isn't silently lost.

Automated Playwright suite: tests/prosperna1/store-locations-arrange.spec.ts + tests/p1-customer/store-locations-customer-order.spec.ts. Screenshot evidence attached.
